title: Incident (v1.0.0)
description: An active incident affecting corridor C6-008. Produced by the data layer (gold view). Screen US-12. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Read contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 produces only 1.0.0.

inc_id.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this incident.

type.description: Incident type. Aligns with incident_report.schema.json in contracts/turn1-events/.

target_id.description: Identifier of the affected bus (B-xxx) or stop (P-xxx).

duration_s.description: Estimated duration in seconds. Null when duration is unknown.

since.description: UTC timestamp when the incident started (event_ts of the originating incident_report event).

until.description: UTC timestamp when the incident was closed. Null while the incident is still active.

reported_by.description: Who reported the incident. 'dispatcher': via UI command_event. 'script': simulator injection via incident_report event in contracts/turn1-events/.
